predecessors.name: Bagratid Armenia
predecessors.text: Kars (Vanand), formed in 963 'by the son of Abas I of Armenia'

successors.name: Byzantine Empire
successors.text: Kars, ceded by Gagik-Abas to the Byzantine Empire in 1065

ledger.x: 963: Mushegh founds the Kingdom of Kars (Vanand).
1065: Gagik-Abas cedes Kars to the Byzantine Empire.
1065: the Kingdom of Kars ends with the cession to Byzantium.

wars.name: Seljuk pressure on Kars
wars.outcome: After Alp Arslan took Ani in 1064 Gagik-Abas paid homage to the Seljuks to spare Kars, then ceded the kingdom to Byzantium in 1065; the Seljuks took Kars soon after.

certainty.note: No boundary on the page; the province of Kars is a soft reading.
